summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine share buyback. It purchased 282,858 of its own ordinary shares from JP Morgan Securities plc at a volume-weighted average price of 11.2013 GBP per share, with no premium or special terms. The shares will be cancelled, reducing the total outstanding count to 2,523,005,655. This is an ordinary-course open-market repurchase under the authority granted at the 2025 AGM, not a formal tender offer or special capital return. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are involved; the filing simply satisfies ongoing reporting obligations for a foreign private issuer. This is not a special situation.
